parsed.title: Sleep, Beacon, Steal, Repeat - The Story of P7 DarkSword Variant
parsed.summary: P7 DarkSword is a previously unseen variant of the DarkSword iOS spyware, identified by iVerify in August 2026 after a customer device alert. The threat actor used a p7_ variable prefix in modifying the original code, and its authors appear to have made deliberate, competent changes rather than relying on AI-assisted edits. Compared with earlier variants, P7 reduces its on-device footprint by removing debug logging and reducing process injections, and uses browser localStorage to prevent re-exploitation. It extracts keychain data into JSON on the device and adds crypto-wallet theft, including support for the imToken wallet app. The implant supports two-way C2 communication via periodic beacons, with a wide range of commands for file theft, photos, Notes, and app data. Defenders should review the report's listed on-device artifacts, network endpoints, and hashes, as the variant's stealth makes heuristic detections and incident response essential.
